widgets_values: Remove the entire background from <image1> and isolate its main foreground subject in one RGBA image with a genuinely transparent alpha channel. Preserve the subject's identity, shape, proportions, position, colors, surface texture, stitching and small details. Keep all intended subject parts and clean fine edges; make background areas visible through handles and other openings transparent too. Remove the supporting surface, surrounding objects and background cast shadows. Do not replace the background with a solid color or a painted checkerboard. Do not add new objects, text, borders or a new drop shadow. Keep the same framing and a single complete subject.
